title: pyrus needhamii
intro: Pyrus needhamii, commonly known as the Chinese pear or Mayflower pear, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. This plant has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, which include treating fever, diarrhea, and respiratory issues, as well as reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Pyrus needhamii are attributed to its ability to clear heat, dispel dampness, and promote fluid circulation, which can help to alleviate symptoms associated with infections and inflammatory conditions. The bioactive constituents of Pyrus needhamii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
